Adjustable handle & hook: Adjustable & sturdy ergonomic 3-step telescoping handle allow you to maneuver in tight spaces and provide effortless movement. The 20 inch suitcase has front hook for bags and side hook for boarding passes.

Ultra-durable zips & Exquisite interior: YKK zips have a stronger bite than ordinary zips and can effectively protect woven zips from tearing. The interior features mesh pockets and elasticated cross straps to ensure you can pack neatly, securely and stay organised.

Multifunctional Suitcases: TSA certified combination locks keep your belongings safe and organised in your luggage. Cup holder on the back to hold a water bottle or coffee cup, freeing up your hands. USB and USB-C charging ports on the side (Power bank not included).
